reason: The revision answers REV-20260930-09: it corrects the evidence-loss denominator and the confirmatory size (about 1,340, not 600), makes extraction-plus-Jev a decisive baseline beside current extraction, freezes segmentation and the overflow rule, scores fact evidence by answer-bearing spans, and orders the freezes so that no label or hash is required before it can exist. It can move B7 (lead) and B11 (working) at the priority 1 ingestion stage, where it decides whether we keep paying for write-time extraction.
